preconditions.description: The input integer x must be between 1 and 100 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (1 <= a <= x and 1 <= b <= x and a * b > x and a // b < x)
postconditions.description: If no valid pair (a, b) is found, output '-1'. Otherwise, output two integers a and b that satisfy the conditions.
